FIELDS.NAME: Precision Auto Repair & Body Shop
FIELDS.DESCRIPTION OF OPERATIONS: At Precision Auto Repair & Body Shop, we specialize in providing high-quality automotive repair and maintenance services primarily for private passenger vehicles. Our operations include routine services such as oil changes, tire rotations, and brake inspections, all performed by certified mechanics in a safe and controlled environment. Our body shop is equipped to handle cosmetic repairs and paintwork efficiently, ensuring each vehicle meets our high standards of quality. We are committed to environmentally compliant waste disposal practices and maintaining a secure facility to protect vehicles and parts. With a focus on customer satisfaction and safety, we operate by appointment to manage workflow effectively, providing reliable service to our valued local clientele.
FIELDS.DESCRIPTION OF LOSSES: On March 10, 2023, a customer vehicle was accidentally damaged while being moved within the shop; the repair cost was $1,200. The claim is processed and settled. On April 15, 2023, a minor electrical fire occurred due to an equipment malfunction, resulting in $2,000 in damages. The incident was addressed, and safety protocols were reviewed; the status is closed.
FIELDS.HOURS OF OPERATION: Monday to Friday, 8:00 AM to 6:00 PM; Saturday 9:00 AM to 3:00 PM; Closed on Sundays.
FIELDS.SAFE/VAULT DETAILS: Heavy-duty safe with UL-rated security, Grade 1.
FIELDS.OTHER PROTECTION: Security fencing and 24-hour video surveillance system.

Our focus is primarily on automotive repair and maintenance for private passenger vehicles, with environmentally compliant practices in place.

FIELDS.G7: Any Workers Compensation carried?: Yes – We carry Workers' Compensation insurance to ensure compliance with legal requirements and to provide coverage for our employees.
FIELDS.G8: Do you own or operate any other busi: No – We do not own or operate any other businesses. Our focus is solely on Precision Auto Repair & Body Shop, specializing in automotive repair and maintenance for private passenger vehicles.
FIELDS.G9: Any other insurance with this compan: No – Precision Auto Repair & Body Shop does not have any other insurance policies with this company at this time. Currently, they are insured under one policy number only.
FIELDS.G10: Are you involved in manufacturing,: No – We are not involved in manufacturing, mixing, relabeling, or repackaging of products. Our operations focus solely on automotive repair and maintenance services for private passenger vehicles.
FIELDS.G11: Do you rent or loan equipment to ot: No – We do not rent or loan equipment to others, as our operations focus exclusively on providing automotive repair and maintenance services for our clients.
FIELDS.G12: Has applicant had a foreclosure, re: No – The applicant has not had any foreclosure, repossession, bankruptcy, judgment, or lien during the past five years.
FIELDS.G13: Any exposure to flammables, explosi: No – We do not have any exposure to flammables, explosives, or chemicals as our operations primarily focus on routine automotive repair and maintenance for private passenger vehicles, utilizing safe and compliant practices.
FIELDS.G14: Any catastrophe exposure?: No – We do not have any catastrophe exposure as our operations are focused solely on automotive repair and maintenance for private passenger vehicles, and we maintain a controlled and secure environment.
FIELDS.G15: Any past losses or claims relating: No – There have been no past losses or claims relating to sexual abuse or molestation allegations, discrimination, or negligent hiring. Our operations have a strong focus on safety and compliance, ensuring a professional environment for all employees and customers.
FIELDS.G16: Any uncorrected fire code violation: No – There are no uncorrected fire code violations. We are committed to maintaining a safe environment and ensuring compliance with all fire safety regulations.
